title: Flatten Utility and Tool Option Trees
description: Remove all unnecessary nestings in utilities and tools. When a utility/tool is activated, show its option tree directly (no duplicate category node). Example: Puzzle 3D Transform shows Transformieren twice and does not show Move flag / Rotate flag options.
summary: Flattened utility/tool option trees at the framework root and wired Puzzle 3D Transform Move/Rotate flags. derive_utility_nodes now hoists single-child groups (no nested Transformieren/Transformieren). partition_window_measures unwraps tagged utility-option groups so activating a utility shows its option children flat. Puzzle 3D: removed lone transform group, added transform Move/Rotate toggles + setTransformGumballFlag + gumballConfig on selection JSON; World3d prefers plugin gumballConfig. Verified: ui_wgpu 7 unit tests + vitest 8 related tests passed. Full puzzle-plugin compile blocked mid-session by concurrent UiPresence migration.
